system.name: WRP (Weight Recover Prune)
system.one_liner: One-shot 2:4 pruning for LLMs that recovers a few critical pruned weights and stores them separately in sparse CSR form.

content.variant_note: one toy 4x8 weight matrix of numbered cells redrawn as dense, 2:4 pruned and recover-weight grids, then compressed into value, index and CSR arrays
content.argues: 2:4 pruning loses some critical weights; recovering a small set and storing it in CSR beside the 2:4 pattern keeps accuracy while the extra index storage stays small.
content.subject: Toy 4x8 weight matrix pruned to 2:4 (values plus 2-bit indices) with recovered weights stored as CSR arrays.

lessons.what_to_learn: Explain a data-format or pruning method on one small matrix with numbered cells, redrawn at the same size after each operation, with one colour per kind of stored content, so a reader can trace any entry by its number.
lessons.suits: Compression, sparsity, quantisation or memory-layout methods whose point is what is stored where, shown on a toy matrix.

Indices storage is the primary additional overhead.
we partition the weight matrix into two separately stored entities

summary: WRP prunes LLM weights one-shot to the hardware-friendly 2:4 pattern but recovers a few critical weights that the pattern would drop and stores them in a separate high-sparsity matrix. Figure 1 shows the storage on one toy 4x8 matrix of numbered cells: the dense matrix is pruned to a 2:4 pattern (two kept cells per group of four, green) and compressed into a values grid and a 2-bit index grid (orange), while the recovered weights 2, 5, 11 and 25 (blue) sit in a second sparse grid that is compressed into the CSR arrays RowOffsets, ColInd and Values. Colour separates payload, recovered weights and index overhead, and operations are named above straight arrows.
summary_zh: WRP 在 2:4 结构化稀疏之外恢复少量关键权重。图 1 用一个编号的 4×8 玩具矩阵演示存储：稠密矩阵剪枝成 2:4 模式并压缩为数值加 2 位索引（绿、橙），被恢复的权重（蓝）另存为 CSR 数组，橙色索引是主要额外开销。
